text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
*pant, pant, pant*...!
...——

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Buena Vista!!
Buena Vista!!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
"Hang in there, keep pushing!!
Buena Viiiiista!!"

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Daaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: (Hearing that roar made my heart tremble to its core. It shone with a fierce, blinding glare—that was...)

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Buena Vista!!
Buena Vista!!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Buena... Vista—

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Tosen Jordan!!
Great race!
You looked so cool out there!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Ah!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
"Flashhh!!
That was so, so thrilling!
I can't wait for your next race!"

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
(...Right.
It's not just Buena-san...)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: (Everyone—)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Win Variation, who put on a phenomenal race at the Japan Cup.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"I suppose the next race would be the Arima Kinen after all.
The Grand Prix race held at year's end for the Umamusume
who made their mark that year—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"With how she is now, she's bound to achieve fantastic results!"
Filled with such eager excitement, I went to meet her, but—

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: The Arima Kinen...!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Huh...!?
Ah, um, that's—
choice_data_list: I want to respect your feelings above all else
I want to put your feelings first, above all else

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
I'm really glad for your suggestion.
I mean, it's the 'Arima Kinen', after all!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
“Or rather, precisely because of that...
it really hit home for me today.”

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"...It just means there's still a lot I need to
polish before I can take center stage."

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
I guess I just got carried away after the Kikuka Sho!
Still, I guess it really was a bit too soon for me.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
You, Jordan-san, and...
Buena-san, too, Flash-san. You all had such an incredible presence, the whole audience couldn't take their eyes off you.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
I need to be able to captivate people's hearts like that!
Otherwise, I won't stand a chance on future stages.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
That's why I want to take a moment
to look back and reflect on myself once more.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
From first position—back to the very basics.
I want to take my time and start over from scratch.
choice_data_list: Got it, let's sit this one out.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"It's a pity, but I don't want to force her to enter.
I want us to move forward in proper lockstep."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "There's no need to rush right now; we just need to move forward in a way she's satisfied with."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, we returned to the waiting room
and discussed our target races in detail.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: The Nikkei Sho...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Nikkei Sho is a GII race known as
a prep race for the Tenno Sho (Spring).

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Considering both our future rotation and her distance aptitude, I think it's a solid target race, but...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Understood!
Sorry about that, and thank you very much!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: (...I turned down their offer after they went out of their way to suggest it. I have to do my best!)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
I'll do my best.
Even more than ever before, more and more...!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Win Variation—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Ah, what's wrong, Orfe?
Are you curious about her?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Approaching Orfevre as she looked down upon the turf
was her older sister—
the intellectual Umamusume, Dream Journey.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
—That fiery hair...
She's the one who stole the cheers that rightfully belonged to the King.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
"I peeked inside to take a look from the outside for once, and...
...I see."

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: "An unquenchable thirst for victory... A singular flame."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
...That's rare.
You seem to really like it.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Hmph.
However, that is not the true path of supremacy.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: The path I seek is one that radiates supreme brilliance.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
"...That path is distorted.
It lacks the acclaim it rightfully deserves."

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: The cause lies with that guy—no, with them.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
"In that case, it must be corrected.
To the 'inevitability' it ought to be."

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, first things first—
To begin with, that guy.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Harboring their own thoughts within—
after taking the time to confront themselves thoroughly,
the pieces were set to advance to the Nikkei Sho.
